t: This is the Sunken House, at 75a De Beauvoir Road in De Beauvoir Town, in the London Borough of Hackney. It was built in 2007 for the photographer Ed Reeve, to a design by David Adjaye. Adjaye is a Ghanaian-British architect whose many buildings around the world include the National Museum of African American History and Culture in Washington, D.C. He was knighted in 2017, and received the Royal Gold Medal in 2021.
